threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You'll know a newbie when they say 'the Tube' instead of just 'the underground.' Classic giveaway.
Caught the N155 last night—two middle-aged gents arguing over who had the worst luck. Best banter I've heard at 2 AM in ages. Only in Clapham.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The first time I saw a guy painting graffiti on a bakery window while the baker served him a coffee. That's Neukölln, vibrant chaos.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how even during a transport strike, the kebab shops in Kreuzberg still manage to stay bustling? It's like they're the real public transport.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to avoid BART after 5 PM; the sound of brakes screeching is a death knell for evening plans. Out-of-towners are clueless.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a bus yesterday that stopped for a pigeon crossing the street. The driver just smiled and said, 'We wait for our locals here.' Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think ‘gràcia’ is just another Gaudí spot, but we actually value our local squares for the social scene, not the architecture.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still pulling out a map in Plaça del Sol, while locals have already switched to their phones for directions.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of just 'going underground'—that gives away you're fresh off the boat, mate.
Caught the 133 last night, driver had a playlist blasting classics. Even the usual drunks sang along, made the whole ride feel like a late-night party.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a spontaneous concert outside my window, just some locals jamming with a guitar and an old violin. Pure Neukölln magic.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a bar that serves beer brewed from leftover bread. Talk about recycling in style!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their ability to navigate the bus delays; they know the secret shortcuts through the alleys that avoid the madness.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught an argument between a driver and a passenger over missing the stop—classic Muni chaos. Only in San Francisco do you get a front-row seat to public drama.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always think Gràcia is just about the parks and Gaudí. They miss the little art galleries and the quiet streets where real life unfolds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them easily; they're the ones taking selfies with their tapas, oblivious to the locals who eat in silence.
